cite.text: Coppedge, Michael, John Gerring, Carl Henrik Knutsen, Staffan I. Lindberg, Jan Teorell, et al. 2026. “V-Dem [Country-Year/Country-Date] Dataset v16.” Varieties of Democracy (V-Dem) Project.

vintages.note: V-Dem's v16 cautionary notes flag convergence issues in the measurement model for two inputs: public goods (v2dlencmps) and educational equality (v2peedueq). On the same country-years, their v16 values correlate 0.997 with v14, and the index correlates 0.999 with v14.

archive.note: V-Dem's v14 notes report test ratings included by mistake for Afghanistan, Burundi, Comoros, Iraq, Lebanon, North Macedonia, Uruguay and Zimbabwe around 1900, 1925, 1950, 1975 and 2000. v16 corrects this, and these country-years account for the largest v14-to-v16 revisions.

scenarios.label: Hong Kong: assume full state authority over territory
scenarios.description: V-Dem does not code state authority over territory (v2svstterr) for Hong Kong, so Hong Kong has no index score. This assumption sets v2svstterr to 100% in every year in which Hong Kong's other inputs are observed. Hong Kong is scored with the same standardisation constants as the baseline, so no other country's score changes.

v2x_rule.name: Rule of law
v2x_rule.question: To what extent are laws transparently, independently, predictably, impartially and equally enforced, and to what extent do the actions of government officials comply with the law?

v2svstterr.name: State authority over territory
v2svstterr.question: Over what percentage of the territory does the state have effective control?

v2clrspct.name: Rigorous and impartial public administration
v2clrspct.question: Are public officials rigorous and impartial in the performance of their duties?

v2dlencmps.name: Particularistic or public goods
v2dlencmps.question: Considering the profile of social and infrastructural spending in the national budget, how 'particularistic' or 'public goods' are most expenditures?

v2stfisccap.name: State fiscal source of revenue
v2stfisccap.question: On which of the following sources of revenue does the central government primarily rely to finance its activities?

v2peedueq.name: Educational equality
v2peedueq.question: To what extent is high-quality basic education guaranteed to all, sufficient to enable them to exercise their basic rights as adult citizens?
